historical_references.reference: Harmeeta Kaur, a prominent Sikh woman leader from Punjab, India, was born on 24 September 1987. She became the youngest president of the Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC) in 2011 at the age of 23. The SGPC is the highest religious authority for Sikhs in the world.
